rows.source_anchor: - **Terminology (`Epoch === Era`) & Data-Driven $N$-Epoch Ladder (`EpochProfileBlueprint[]`)**:
rows.source_text:
- **Terminology (`Epoch === Era`) & Data-Driven $N$-Epoch Ladder (`EpochProfileBlueprint[]`)**:
      Throughout Uplift, **`Epoch` and `Era` are 100% synonymous** (`Epoch 1 === Era 1`; code and schemas use `epochId`). The **7-Epoch / 7-Era Grand Civilizational Arc** below is the **default data-driven campaign ladder** ($N \ge 1$, where the final entry has `isTerminalEpoch: true`), **never a hardcoded engine constant** — Epochs can be added, removed, split, or reordered in content configuration at any time:
      1. **Epoch 1 (Era 1) — Feudal** (*Highglass Hold*: feudal court, guilds, Synod orthodoxy, horse couriers, naked-eye omens, Witch-Hunt Inquisition)
      2. **Epoch 2 (Era 2) — Renaissance** (printing charters, optical lenses, merchant banking houses, humanist inquiry vs. dogmatic rifts)
      3. **Epoch 3 (Era 3) — Pre-Industrial / Colonial** (chartered trading companies, optical semaphore & post networks, navigational observatories, mercantilist resource wars)
      4. **Epoch 4 (Era 4) — Industrial / WWI-Equivalent** (steam/coal/rail, telegraph wires, mass conscription, factory labor vs. capital, industrial/chemical warfare dual-use ceilings)
      5. **Epoch 5 (Era 5) — Cold-War-Era Equivalent** (ideological blocs, radio/television/CRT, nuclear/strategic deterrence dual-use ceilings, intelligence agencies & black-sites)
      6. **Epoch 6 (Era 6) — Computer-Age** (global digital networks, email/cloned ledger hashes, algorithmic surveillance, corporate/state information monopolies)
      7. **Epoch 7 (Era 7) — Space-Age / First-Contact (`isTerminalEpoch: true`)** (orbital telemetry/satellites, indigenous planetary defense capable of deflecting the Intersecting Comet, culminating in First Contact readiness)
rows.notes: All seven rung exemplars and terminal/data-driven N constraints remain design, not engine constants.

rows.group: Concept, Setting & Multi-Epoch Continuity:
rows.source_anchor: - **Uplift-Compressed Generational Flow & Anti-Over-Acceleration Ceilings (`EpochTechCeilingBlueprint`)**:
rows.source_text:
- **Uplift-Compressed Generational Flow & Anti-Over-Acceleration Ceilings (`EpochTechCeilingBlueprint`)**:
      Your covert Uplift presence compresses 600–800 years of natural history into **generational intervals (`15–30 years` between operatives: `4–6 years` of post-climax work before extraction + `11–24 years` before the next operative lands, totaling `~110–200 in-world years` across a 7-Epoch run)** so surviving `youth`/`prime` NPCs from Epoch $k$ are still alive as `prime`/`elder` in adjacent Epoch $k+1$ (`youth -> prime -> elder -> succeeded_by_heir`) and personally remember your predecessor while living through rapid civilizational transformation.
      Strict per-Epoch ceilings (`maxTechTierForEpoch`, `maxMaturationStepPerTransition = 1`, and societal `absorptionCapacity`) guarantee that mechanics compress the *time between Epochs* to match our pacing design without ever skipping an Epoch rung or breaking an Epoch's internal coherence.
      Advancing triggers a 4-panel procedural chiaroscuro **Extraction & Reunion Still Sequence**, runs `runInterEpochMaturation`, exports a `CivilizationLegacyState` snapshot with **Dual Legacy Ledgers** (**Material Scars** vs **Veil Scars**), grafts visible/uncoverable **Predecessor Traces** onto `semanticId` stage walls/props, unlocks expanded landing choices, and lets the new operative choose between **Claiming Kinship (`kin_claim`)** or **Starting Afresh (`fresh_start`)**.
rows.notes: 600–800, 15–30, 4–6, 11–24, ~110–200, one-rung ceiling, scars/traces and kin/fresh exemplars preserved.

- **In-Game Debug Mode (`F3` / backtick), Stage/Wardrobe Labs (Sound Lab planned) & Agent DOM Mirror**:
      Pauses 60Hz kinematics, cognitive pulses, and watch advancement (planned: 05b-1-watch-clock-and-time-spend), desaturates the frozen world by 40%, morphs the audio bus into a frozen room-tone grain + 1 Hz lace pulse (planned: 05a-audio-engine), de-anchors the camera for free movement, and renders floating state inspector cards over targeted NPCs/props/surfaces. Planned: lab mode becomes a `PlaySession` flag that also holds the single domain freeze bit (time freezes, effects still reduce and return outcomes), and free-cam keys are gated on lab mode, not on `isPaused()` (planned: hx-reducer-and-frame-safety).
      Every 3D wall segment, floor, prop, light, and character part carries a deterministic **`semanticId`** (`charnel_stairs.wall.north.seg_02`, `npc.sorrel.part.headgear`) built from the 3-Layer Encoded Visual Framework (`SceneVisualBlueprints.ts`: `EpochVisualTheme` + `StageSceneBlueprint` + `CharacterVisualBlueprint`, starter constants in `defaultStageContent.ts`, and parametric builders in `StageKitbashBuilders.ts` & `ChiaroscuroStageRenderer.ts`).
      `StageInspectorDomMirror` mirrors `data-active-space-id`, `data-hovered-semantic-id`, `data-selected-semantic-id`, `data-debug-paused`, `data-camera-mode`, and `globalThis.__UPLIFT_STAGE_INSPECTOR__` so the AI agent can directly inspect the live DOM and take screenshots via `cursor-ide-browser`, and the `F3` Stage/Wardrobe Lab (`GET`/`PUT /api/scene-blueprints/:stageId`, `GET`/`PUT /api/character-visuals/:characterId`) persist live UI tweaks back to `src/content/`. The `F3` Sound Lab (`PUT /api/audio-patches`, planned: 05a-sound-lab) and the `F3` Pacing Lab (`PUT /api/pacing-profiles/:profileId`, planned: 05b-2-storylets-and-lab) will do the same through the guarded bridge write-route helper (planned, built by hx-ops-safety).

Until the pack loader exists, an F3 stage-lab save writes JSON the game does not load. Lab JSON is planned to become the source of truth, checked at runtime through `validateLaunch` (planned: pre-05b-pack-source-of-truth).

- Strict TypeScript, ESLint, Prettier & Zero `any` Policy (non-negotiable):
      `tsconfig.json` MUST enforce `"strict": true`, `"noImplicitAny": true`, `"strictNullChecks": true`, `"noUncheckedIndexedAccess": true`, `"exactOptionalPropertyTypes": true`, and `"noImplicitOverride": true`.
      Both implicit `any` and explicit `any` (`: any`, `as any`, `<any>`, `any[]`, `Record<string, any>`) are strictly forbidden across `src/` and `tests/` and enforced by both ESLint (`@typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any`) and `tests/architecture/layer_boundaries.test.ts` during `npm run verify`.
      Prettier formats on save (`.vscode/settings.json`), and Husky + `lint-staged` run ESLint and Prettier on every `git commit`.

      1. NPCs must never speed-run through multi-step plots at CPU speed during live gameplay. Every behavior progresses through human-paced phases (`deliberating` -> `moving` -> `performing_dwell` -> `cooldown` or `awaiting_trigger` when waiting for the next player-created trigger).

NPC-to-NPC trigger cascades (`enqueue_npc_stimulus`) enforce a digestion delay with exponential hop backoff (`cascadeHopCount` capped by `maxAutonomousCascadeHops`, default `2`) and a staggered token-bucket scheduler (`maxCognitiveEvaluationsPerPulse = 1`) so NPC-to-NPC interactions never cause a thundering herd.
      3. All pacing/cascade limits and watch-gate scales are controlled via `SimulationPacingConfig` (`DEFAULT_GAMEPLAY_PACING_CONFIG` for live play vs. `FAST_EVAL_PACING_CONFIG` with `storytellerMinWatchScale: 0` added by 05b-2-envelopes-and-gates (planned) for automated tests and AI evals) so headless tests and evals can simulate a full Epoch in milliseconds.

      Once all tasks in a change are marked complete, launch 6 parallel review subagents (using Composer 2.5 Fast or Grok 4.7 High Fast) to audit the delivered change across six axes:
      1. Adversarial Review (edge cases, failure modes, concurrency/race conditions, invalid inputs)
